//: The regional directory behind the country chooser on Safety and Support.
//not_detected: Rule 7: the visitor chooses their country. Nothing here detects location, and nothing about the choice is stored or sent anywhere — it changes what the page shows and is forgotten when the page is.
//nothing_verified: Every country below has an empty entries list, so every choice shows the emergency-service message and the plain statement that no service is listed for that country yet. That is the honest state: the candidate directories for Thailand and Canada are marked NOT VERIFIED in docs/, and rule 7 forbids publishing them as they are. Only the country names are used here, never their entries.
//before_publishing: An entry may be added only once it records, per the draft: the official source; countries or regions served; hours and contact methods; languages; cost and eligibility; whether contact may appear on a phone bill; and the date last verified. Every country needs an emergency number, a national domestic-abuse or sexual-violence helpline, a crisis or mental-health line, and a legal-advice or legal-aid service. Re-verify at least every six months.
//international_directory: The draft asks for a link to an independently maintained international directory where no verified entry exists. None has been chosen, so it renders as a placeholder.
